pid.description: The target process ID (decimal) to scan and modify.

initial_value.description: The current known value of the target variable to begin the search.

initial_range.description: An optional range specification (e.g., '0..100') if the exact value is unknown but bounded.

scan_type.description: The data type to scan for (int, float, string).

commands.description: A list of scanmem commands to execute non-interactively (e.g., 'set 100', 'watch 0'). Items are flat strings representing commands.

debug.description: Enable debug mode for verbose output.

err_exit.description: Exit on initial commands error, ignored during interactive mode.
